rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=14, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). ONE KNOB: epochs 8 -> 14 (all else = iter-1 exactly: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX: (1) iter-1 = val_ssim 0.895903 / hr 0.268409 / PSNR 36.79 / RMSE 0.000723 at 8 epochs; FULL JOB elapsed 737.85s = 12.30 min (sacct 12:18), well under the 20-min train+score budget AND the 30-min sbatch wall; the train phase did NOT hit max_train_s=900 (all 8 epochs printed). (2) OPPORTUNITY = UNDER-TRAINED at the budget: 8 epochs converged in 12.3 min leaving ~7.7 min of unused compute; itnet-family knob insights name EPOCHS as the dominant lever (discarded boundary-slice run hinted ep40 peak -- behavior hint only, not a validated number). (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 8->14 (~1.75x more training). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if itnet_v3 trains 14 epochs instead of 8 (all else fixed), hr rises above 0.268 because the iter-1 net is under-trained (converged in 12.3/20 min) and epochs is the itnet lever. FALSIFIER: hr <= 0.268 at 14 epochs => itnet_v3 is NOT epochs-limited at lr=1e-4/c=16 (already converged OR lr too low to use the extra steps) and iter-3 must pivot the lever (lr or unet_c). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score): iter-1 train ~65 s/epoch (738s total - ~240s fixed val/figure/startup) / 8 = ~62-68 s/ep; 14 epochs ~= 910s train, fenced by the unchanged max_train_s=900 backstop (checks between epochs => completes the epoch in progress, so ~14 epochs land ~900s) + ~240s 214-slice per-sample val + figure ~= 19 min, inside 20-min and well inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; no fov= override). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign.
